system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: pmfby_verify_otp and pmfby_track_survey_status. For your information, my aadhaar_number is 100020006846, my claim_id is None, my otp is dummy_otp_6382.

function.name: pmfby_track_survey_status
function.description: Tracks the field survey status for a PMFBY claim. Returns survey_status ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed') and surveyor details. Survey/assessment is required before claim approval. Requires session_token. This tool does NOT initiate surveys or modify results. Fails if claim_id is invalid or no survey has been assigned.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier of the insurance claim.

function.name: pmfby_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies the OTP and returns a session_token for PMFBY operations. The OTP must have been generated via pmfby_generate_otp. This tool does NOT check policy status or process claims — it only authenticates. Fails if OTP is expired, incorrect, or not generated.

otp.description: 6-digit OTP received on the registered mobile number.
